mobbin:9f1a536c-16bb-424e-a558-0604130c4.summary: Guest opens 'End trip' with time remaining, documents with photos, reviews host and guest sets, accepts liability on 'Finish checkout', and lands on trip-ended with a timestamp.
steps: End trip panel with time remaining
steal: The pre-return screen shows a countdown ('ends in 2h 30m'), Change trip, Report damage, and End trip that needs a short inspection before checkout (screen 1).
Photo guidance shows a recommended area count, 'View all exterior areas', a why-it-matters callout, Take photos vs Upload from Photos, and Skip allowed (screens 2–3).
A shared photo log sections by party (host vs guest) with per-photo timestamps before Continue (screen 5).
'Finish checkout' requires agreeing the inspection is accurate and you are liable for unreported damage, then Submit shows Trip ended time and notifies the other party (screen 7).
avoid: Requiring about 15 exterior plus about 8 interior photos for every sim-equipment return. Scale documentation to high-value assets only.
mobbin:9f1a536c-16bb-424e-a558-0604130c4.fit: Inventory: fills the undefined return and damage path for manual check-out: condition photos, evidence from both parties, liability confirm, and an explicit return time before the item is free again.

mobbin:928e0f27-77e0-456e-b079-4914013cb.summary: From Pickup and return hours, host opens 'Block availability' (empty), sets start and end date-time with calendar and time wheels, and confirms Add for a blocked window.
steal: When nothing is blocked, 'No hours blocked' and 'Block availability' appear, noting host unavailability is not vehicle unavailability, with 'Go to Calendar' to block the asset itself (screen 2).
The block form has Start and End date plus time, a month calendar on the form, a 30-minute time drum, and a single Add to commit (screens 3–6).
Always available and per-weekday Available hours sit beside Block availability for one-off windows (screen 1).
mobbin:928e0f27-77e0-456e-b079-4914013cb.fit: Inventory: maps to equipment scheduling and conflict handling: block a manikin or room for maintenance or exclusive use so two scenarios cannot claim the same asset. Keep the job as check-out-manual among current ids.
